Context: 3. Date of Birth and its subsequent alteration

In the absence of such proof, he may declare approximate age or year or month and year of birth; assumed date of birth will be arrived at as under:  
- (i) If the approximate age only is declared, the number of years representing the age declared to be deducted and the assumed
- date arrived at.
- If the year of birth only is declared, assumed date will be 1st July
- (ii) of the year.
- If the month and the year are declared, assumed date will be
- (iii) 16th of that month of the year.
